narrationDirection: Perform this original Thai romantic comedy finale as a native Bangkok Thai man telling a friend an embarrassing true story that ended well. Same warm male narrator as Parts 1-2. Brisk, connected conversational phrasing with varied stress. Open low and tense on the name. The question is steady. Her hurt line lands quiet. The lobby line is a quick comic aside. The cat reveal is a stunned beat, then he laughs at himself. The anniversary memory is sincere and slow. In the dark he is ashamed, almost a whisper. The doors moment builds: hesitation, then resolve. The public ask is loud and nervous. Her answer is warm and dry. The final question is direct to the viewer. Read only the provided Thai text; do not speak these instructions or bracketed delivery tags.
